trucks.name: 12 Foot Box Truck
trucks.description: Ideal for small apartments, studio moves, or small business deliveries. Fits in standard parking spaces.

trucks.name: 16 Foot Box Truck
trucks.description: A versatile workhorse for 1-2 bedroom moves or medium-volume business deliveries.

trucks.name: Delivery Truck With Shelves
trucks.description: Same body size as the 16-foot but fitted with built-in shelving — designed for organized package/parts delivery, not bulk moving.

trucks.name: 16 and 18 Foot Cabover Truck
trucks.description: Higher payload capacity than standard box trucks. Cabover design improves visibility in urban environments.

trucks.name: 18 to 22 Foot Step Van
trucks.description: Walk-in step van body with easy side/rear access. Common for route delivery, catering, and mobile businesses.

trucks.name: 22 to 26 Foot Box Truck (Non-CDL)
trucks.description: Large-capacity truck that stays under the 26,001 lb CDL threshold. The go-to for large household moves without needing a commercial license.

trucks.name: 22 to 26 Foot Box Truck (CDL)
trucks.description: Identical body to the Non-CDL version but rated for significantly higher payload. Requires a valid Commercial Driver License. Best for heavy industrial, construction, or freight loads.
